The evidence suggests that Cortisone Acetate may exert its therapeutic effects through anti-inflammatory mechanisms, which could alleviate symptoms of both conditions. The presence of a direct indication from Cortisone Acetate to Allergic Rhinitis implies a potential role in the pathophysiology of the condition, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated.
